labels: Arms long, hinge forward a little
Sweep the bar down to your thighs
Let it rise to head height, arms straight

text.setup: Face a high pulley with a straight bar or rope. Step back, hinge forward slightly and hold the bar at head height with straight arms.
cues: Keep your arms straight and sweep the bar down in an arc.
Finish with the bar at your thighs and your lats squeezed.
Let it rise back to head height without bending the elbows.
mistakes: Bending the elbows so it turns into a pushdown.
Rocking the body to move the weight.
Shrugging as the bar comes up.

variants.cable: A rope lets your hands finish beside your hips.
variants.resistance_band: Anchor the band high in front of you.
